_comment: Nokia 6103 keypad -> Megadrive pad. The phone (CpcPad MIDlet) is output-agnostic: it reports the raw physical key -- digits '0'..'9','*','#' for the keypad, 'K<code>' for device-specific keys. Pluto owns the mapping HERE: 'controls' maps phone key -> DC button. Snake-on-the-numpad d-pad (2 up / 8 down / 4 left / 6 right), face diamond on 1/3/7/9, 5 = Start. Shoulders L/R = the two SOFT keys (left-soft K-4, right-soft K-3) -- NOT the volume keys, which the phone captures for its own volume and never reach the app.
